SantaNightmare — controls checked against original numbered BASIC lines

Three instruction pages explain five stages (BASIC 9210-9270). The game asks for four separate keys (60-100). Replay defines A = left, D = right, W = up, S = down, advances the first-stage reminder, waits for the traffic-light countdown, and uses A and D to steer Santa during the tree-avoidance stage (1900-1960).

Replay uses the untouched .z80 snapshot in Fuse SDL 1.6.0, 48K ROM,
100% emulation speed; injects actual keyboard presses over XTest.
Captures 01-STATE.png after the first move and 02-AFTER-MOVES.png after
the second. Delays are real elapsed seconds, not exact game frames.
